title: Technician filter on the expanded technician charts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. People: at least two technicians have clocked time on invoiced work order lines this month in this location.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Read the filter button at the top right of the chart.
  4. Click the filter button and read the list.
  5. Untick every technician except two (keep any two).
  6. Close the list and read the chart's legend and lines.
  7. Click View details on the Technician Utilization tile.
  8. Repeat the last four steps on the Technician Utilization chart.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each of the two technician charts has a Technician filter, reading Technician: All technicians before you change it.
  • The list lets you tick more than one technician, and every technician starts ticked.
  • After keeping two technicians the chart reloads and shows only those two: the legend names only them and only two lines are drawn.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts each have a Technician filter.”
  • S8-R2: “The Technician filter lets the user select any number of technicians and defaults to all technicians selected.”
  • S8-R5: “When the user changes a chart filter, the chart reloads scoped to the selected technicians or advisor.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
